response.message: We're building a cited Q&A assistant on IBM Cloud. It answers from a small synthetic document collection, uses keyword retrieval and filters results by each user's permissions before the model sees them. In the first local test, synthetic users sign in and ask questions, and a mocked model returns scripted answers, which only proves the routing, permission filtering and citation handling; checking real watsonx.ai answer quality, model access and region availability needs a separate run on a real IBM account, and nothing here has been deployed or verified yet. Which country does the data need to stay in, so we can choose a region?

proposal.title: IBM Cloud cited Q&A assistant: first end-to-end sketch
proposal.body: Scope: a synthetic qualification of a cited Q&A assistant on IBM Cloud, covering ingestion, permission-aware keyword retrieval, watsonx.ai model runtime, App ID sign-in and an authenticated web app. Assumptions: the region is not selected yet; the services are design-only, with no typed IBM generator except storage; model access, region support and interoperability have not been verified; nothing has been deployed.

data.label: Synthetic test user (browser)
data.description: Synthetic test person using a browser. This is a client reference and is not provisioned.

data.label: Q&A web app
data.description: Authenticated web app. Sends the user to App ID to sign in, calls the RAG API with the user's token, and shows each answer with its citations.

data.label: Sign-in & identity
data.description: Handles user sign-in for synthetic users through OIDC with PKCE. Issues tokens that the RAG API validates, and the user identity and groups are used for ACL filtering.

data.label: RAG API (keyword retrieval)
data.description: Validates the App ID token, runs bounded keyword search on the catalog, removes passages the user isn't allowed to see (fails closed), prompts watsonx.ai using only permitted passages, and returns a cited answer or declines.

data.label: Keyword catalog + ACLs
data.description: Stores document chunks, keyword terms, source revisions and the explicit ACLs for each document. Only the ingestion job writes to it; the RAG API reads from it.

data.label: Synthetic document store
data.description: Private bucket holding the small synthetic document collection and an ACL manifest for each document.

data.label: Ingestion job
data.description: Reads the documents and their ACLs, splits documents into chunks, extracts keywords and writes them to the catalog with conditional writes, keeping each source's permissions.

data.label: Model runtime
data.description: Generates grounded answers from the permitted passages. In local tests the model is mocked; the real model ID, access, quota and region still need verification.

data.label: Audit & logs
data.description: Logs requests, access denials and citations for audit. Does not log document text or tokens.

requirementDrafts.rationale: Without this, the model could quote restricted content to unauthorised users.
requirementDrafts.basis: User: "keep all source permissions" and "identity enforcement".
requirementDrafts.statement: Proposed: retrieval returns only passages from documents the signed-in user may open, using the ACLs stored with each document at ingestion; unknown users or documents fail closed.

requirementDrafts.rationale: Citations make answers checkable; declining avoids unsupported answers.
requirementDrafts.basis: User: "Answer questions over a small synthetic document collection with citations".
requirementDrafts.statement: Proposed: every answer cites the source documents it used, and the assistant declines to answer when no permitted passage matches.

requirementDrafts.rationale: Mocked responses can't show real model quality, quotas or entitlement.
requirementDrafts.basis: User: "distinguish mocked model behavior from actual model validation".
requirementDrafts.statement: Proposed: treat local tests with a mocked model as proof of the pipeline only; validate watsonx.ai model access, region and answer quality separately on a real account.

response.message: Here's the good news: the emulation found no failing checks, and every flow we drew is connected. It's blocked because none of the eight IBM components has a native implementation yet. The supported typed contracts only cover this RAG pattern on AWS, plus IBM private object storage on its own, and switching to storage-only would cut the scope you asked for. So a graph edit can't fix this. The fix is product engineering: native IBM implementations for App ID with PKCE, the Code Engine web app, the Code Engine RAG API, Cloudant with ACLs, the ingestion job and the watsonx.ai runtime, plus an import plan for the existing browser reference. Artifact f6ebbc12… is the reproducer, and nothing has been deployed or validated. For this test, should the IBM services stay as they are and wait for those implementations, or would you accept running the AWS-supported RAG pattern alongside as a reference while IBM remains the target?
